question_answered: Why was this formative study conducted, and how was it structured?
What did participants discuss in the first, background-interview part of the session?
What mock-ups were shown to participants in the second part of the session, and what prior work inspired them?
How were the mock-ups used methodologically, and how was the resulting data analyzed?
What challenges did participants report with existing tools for reading and gathering information from papers?
How did participants typically compare papers in practice, absent tool support?
How did participants react to the alignment and highlighting mock-ups?
What feedback did participants give on the custom search/highlight-based query mock-up, and what concerns did they raise?
